name: Japheth
overview: Japheth, one of Noah's three sons, played a vital role in God's preservation of humanity during the great flood, as recorded in Genesis where he entered the ark with his family (Genesis 7:13). Scripture highlights Japheth's prudence and respect in the incident of Noah's drunkenness, where he, along with Shem, covered their father's nakedness without looking upon it (Genesis 9:23). God’s blessing upon Japheth includes a promise of enlargement and dwelling in the tents of Shem, indicating a future of growth and favor (Genesis 9:27). Japheth’s descendants, preserved through the ark, represent a significant part of the post-flood world’s population (Genesis 9:18).
